# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are accepted for the latest published release of:

- `frappe-js-client`
- `frappe-codegen`

Older major versions are unsupported unless a release is still marked current on npm.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not** open a public issue for security reports.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/dhiashalabi/frappe-js-client/security/advisories/new).

Include:

- Affected package name and version
- Impact (what an attacker can do)
- Reproduction steps or a proof of concept
- Any known workarounds

You should get an acknowledgement within 7 days. Please do not disclose the issue publicly until a fix is released or we agree on a disclosure date.
